newsitem.title: CHINA: China premier congratulates new Indian PM.
newsitem.headline: China premier congratulates new Indian PM.

text.p: Chinese Premier Li Peng on Monday congratulated new Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral, voicing hope that Sino-Indian ties would improve further during the new leader's tenure, the Xinhua news agency said.

"It is the common aspiration of the two governments and two peoples to build Sino-Indian future-oriented constructive and cooperative partnership," Xinhua quoted Li as saying in the message to Gujral.
Friendly and good-neighbourly relations and cooperation served the fundamental interests of both nations and also of regional peace and stability, he said.
Beijing and Delhi fought a brief war over sections of their 4,000-km (2,500-mile) border in 1962, but tensions between the two Asian giants have eased after years of talks.

A state visit to India last November by Chinese President Jiang Zemin concluded with an agreement that aimed to further reduce tensions along the border and could also lead to weapon and troop cutbacks.
